lemmas.statement: On the measured rectangle (five stakes, two measures, at most three items, arity two, fifteen rounds, guard 250 nodes), none of the 1680 retained V1 minimum response edges carries a datum. This is a finite result on the measured V1 tree only and does not decide Challenge 1.
Auxiliary bookkeeping: of the 1974 frontier nodes, 1039 stopped at the guard, so 935 did not. This is not a coverage claim, because targets after a node's first refusal were not searched.

near_misses.claim: Since no datum appears on the 1680 retained edges, the stream is not a response.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The search is bounded: 1039 frontier nodes were stopped at the guard, targets after a node's first refusal were not searched, and the four-item prediction R1-X was not computed. Absence of evidence on a finite tree is not impossibility, so Challenge 1 stays OPEN.

near_misses.claim: At two items a fresh datum is valid, so the stream is a response at two items.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The datum is priced out in 219 rows, and no response edge carries a datum at two items. Validity alone does not make it a response.

open_obligations: No @SRC or @KNOWN+ declarations were given, so there are no existing citations and every reference is proposed_new.
Generators were not grounded: the supply, admission and response operations have no cited declarations.
No relations or compositions were proposed, because none can be licensed without grounded generators.
Lean formalisation of the V1 tree, the response-edge predicate and the datum-carrying predicate is not done.
The four-item prediction R1-X was not computed.
Targets after a node's first refusal were not searched.
Frontier nodes stopped at the guard (1039 across six runs) were not explored.
A rule is needed to decide whether the stream is a response, since the measured tree cannot settle it.
